name: War Room
summary: Deep inside Stormwind Keep, the War Room gathers the arms, records, and charts used to plan the Alliance’s defense.

sections.title: Nerve Center of the Keep
sections.body: Beyond Stormwind Keep’s grand chambers, commanders turn to military logistics and high-level campaign planning. Swords, blunderbusses, and heavy artillery cannons line the stone walls. Military treatises and chronicles of past wars fill nearby tables. At the center, a large map lets commanders assess Alliance deployments across Azeroth, while the royal court handles affairs of state just steps away.

faq.q: Where is the War Room located?
faq.answer: Deep inside Stormwind Keep, beyond its central corridors, the War Room has heavy fortifications, weapon racks, and a large tactical map table.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this room?
aliases: why does the keep have a war room
faq.answer: The War Room is the Alliance military’s strategic planning headquarters within Stormwind. High commanders review intelligence, coordinate troop movements, and study conflicts past and present.

faq.q: What historical lore can be found here?
faq.answer: The tables hold books on military strategy and chronicles of the kingdom’s past wars, close at hand for commanders planning Alliance campaigns.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier or champion, you can look to the War Room for plans to defend the realm from lingering threats across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond.
As a warrior, you may value the military order kept inside Stormwind Keep, among its heavy munitions and strategic maps.
